executive_summary: 99 Speed Mart delivered record first-quarter revenue of RM3.07 billion, up 17.5% year-on-year, driven by 253 net new outlets and a richer non-essential product mix. Net profit rose 30.1% to RM188.6 million as gross margin expanded to 20.4% and energy-saving initiatives lowered operating costs. The Group declared a first interim dividend of 2.25 sen per share. Management remains confident on continued network expansion through FY2026.

management_commentary.performance_review: Revenue growth was led by an enlarged store network and a higher contribution from non-essential products, which carry better margins. Gross profit margin improved to 20.4% from 19.9% a year earlier. Energy-saving efficiencies and operating leverage lifted profit before tax by 29.9% year-on-year.
management_commentary.qoq_commentary: Against the immediately preceding quarter, revenue rose 2.1% and profit after tax was up 2.8%, reflecting continued outlet additions despite a seasonally softer period.
management_commentary.prospects: Management expects the outlet expansion programme to continue through FY2026, supported by the Group's distribution-centre network. Consumer demand for value retail is expected to remain resilient.
key_initiatives: Open new outlets across underserved townships

red_flags: Prior year figures restated — supplier rebates reclassified from other income to a deduction against cost of sales.
Related party transactions exceeding RM60 million with director-related entities (rental and supply arrangements).
Contingent liability: RM11 million bank guarantee issued in favour of suppliers and utility providers.
highlights: Record quarterly revenue of RM3.07 billion, up 17.5% YoY.
PAT grew 30.1% YoY to RM188.6 million on improved product mix and energy efficiencies.
First interim dividend of 2.25 sen per share declared.
Store network expanded by 253 outlets YoY to 3,086 stores.
